capsuleTopic.title: Twelve Spies
capsuleTopic.subtitle: Land · report · refusal · pardon · rest
capsuleTopic.orientation: Enter the mission in Numbers, inspect where the report divides, and follow refusal, intercession, pardon, sentence, delayed entry, inheritance, and later memory without merging the witnesses.
capsuleTopic.trailPrompt: Notice what the men observe together, where their judgments separate, how the assembly responds, what Moses asks, what the sentence reverses, and how later Scripture remembers unbelief and rest.
